name: container-restart
description: Conteneur redémarré dans le namespace demo au cours des 5 dernières minutes

query_condition.sql: SELECT k8s_pod_name, k8s_container_name, max(k8s_container_status_last_terminated_reason) AS reason, CAST(max(value) - min(value) AS BIGINT) AS restarts FROM "k8s_container_restarts" WHERE k8s_namespace_name = 'demo' GROUP BY k8s_pod_uid, k8s_pod_name, k8s_container_name HAVING max(value) > min(value)
